title: Estimating the Economic Effects of Federally Funded R&D
title_zh: 联邦资助研发的经济效应估算
authors: Sheila Campbell, Jaeger Nelson, Eli A. Schrag, Heidi L. Williams, Caleb K. Wroblewski
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: In recent years, there has been Congressional interest in changing various policies related to research and development (R&D). Recent legislation has included provisions that would modify federal funding for R&D investments and tax provisions affecting the after-tax price of R&D. The Congressional Budget Office (CBO) has developed analytical frameworks for estimating how changes in R&D investments affect the economy and the federal budget. This paper describes the agency’s current analytical framework for modeling the economic effects of changes in federal funding for R&D, focusing on two distinct approaches that CBO has developed: an R&D capital stock approach and an R&D components approach.
abstract_zh: 近年来，国会一直关注调整与研发相关的各项政策。近期立法中包含了修改联邦研发投资资金条款以及影响研发税后价格的税收条款。国会预算办公室（CBO）已建立分析框架，用于估算研发投资变化对经济和联邦预算的影响。本文阐述了该机构当前用于模拟联邦研发资金变化经济效应的分析框架，重点介绍CBO开发的两种不同方法：研发资本存量法和研发要素法。

title: Strategic communication among banks
authors: Christian Bittner, Falko Fecht, Melissa Pala, Farzad Saidi
abstract: How do bank networks facilitate information flows that shape market outcomes? Using international banks’ advisory activities in corporate takeovers as their source of private information, we show in supervisory data that banks with closer ties to the target, but not the acquirer, advisor trade profitably in the target’s stock prior to the deal announcement. This trading behavior is associated with a higher premium paid without compromising deal success. As connected banks’ incentives are aligned only with target shareholders’ interests, which are represented by the target advisor, our evidence suggests that economic incentives determine which banks share information and with whom.
abstract_zh: 银行网络如何促进信息流动并影响市场结果？利用国际银行在企业并购中的顾问活动作为其私有信息来源，我们在监管数据中发现，与目标公司（而非收购方）关系更密切的银行顾问会在交易公告前通过目标公司股票交易获利。这种交易行为与支付更高溢价相关，且不影响交易成功率。由于关联银行的激励仅与目标股东利益一致（由目标顾问代表），我们的证据表明，经济激励决定了哪些银行共享信息以及与谁共享。

title: Inflation after the Iran war
title_zh: 伊朗战争后的通货膨胀
official: 官方在线 2026-07-16 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: An unexpected increase in energy costs raises inflation directly through flexibly-set prices. Whether that shock amplifies to a larger and persistent rise in inflation depends on its transmission through the economy. This paper examines four channels of transmission of the Iran conflict to inflation in the EA, UK, and the US. The first is the transmission to the sticky prices in core sectors. Recent advances in menu cost models predict that inflation will rise faster than usual and monetary policy is less powerful to curb it. The second is transmission to spending, wages, and nominal returns through higher expected inflation. The empirical literature on household and firm inflation expectations points to some evidence for this amplification. The third channel is through other aggregate demand policies, especially fiscal policy. The IMF reassessments of the fiscal outlook provide some guarded grounds for optimism. The fourth mechanism is through an erosion in the credibility of the long-run inflation target. Data from market prices indicates that the inflation anchor has not moved. All combined, the data as of May 2026 suggests that the Iran war shock will have a significant impact on inflation that persists into 2027, but that is smaller and more short-lived than the 2021--24 inflation disaster.
abstract_zh: 能源成本的意外上升会通过灵活定价直接推高通胀。这种冲击是否会放大为更大规模且持续的通胀上升，取决于其在经济中的传导机制。本文考察了伊朗冲突对欧元区、英国和美国通胀的四种传导渠道。第一种是向核心部门粘性价格的传导。菜单成本模型的最新进展预测，通胀将以快于往常的速度上升，而货币政策抑制通胀的效果将减弱。第二种是通过更高的通胀预期向支出、工资和名义回报的传导。关于家庭和企业通胀预期的实证研究为这种放大效应提供了一定证据。第三种渠道是通过其他总需求政策，尤其是财政政策。国际货币基金组织对财政前景的重新评估为乐观情绪提供了审慎依据。第四种机制是通过侵蚀长期通胀目标的公信力。市场价格数据显示，通胀锚并未发生偏移。综合来看，截至2026年5月的数据表明，伊朗战争冲击将对通胀产生显著影响，并持续至2027年，但其影响程度小于2021-2024年的通胀灾难，且持续时间更短。

title: Quantifying the Role of Firms in Intergenerational Mobility
title_zh: 量化企业在代际流动中的作用
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We quantify the role of firms in intergenerational mobility using administrative data from Israel. We decompose the intergenerational elasticity of earnings (IGE) into an individual-IGE and a firm-IGE using an AKM framework. The firm-IGE—reflecting the sorting of children from higher-income families into better-paying firms—accounts for 23 percent of the IGE.We then explore underlying mechanisms. While skill transmission explains part of the firm- IGE, roughly half cannot be accounted for by skill differences. Moreover, sector-level sorting explains a large share of the firm-IGE, indicating that structural barriers across sectors—rather than firm-level discrimination— are a key driver of intergenerational sorting.
abstract_zh: 我们利用以色列行政数据量化了企业在代际流动中的作用。通过AKM框架，我们将代际收入弹性（IGE）分解为个体IGE和企业IGE。企业IGE——反映高收入家庭子女进入高薪酬企业的分类效应——解释了IGE的23%。随后我们探究了潜在机制。尽管技能传递解释了部分企业IGE，但约一半无法由技能差异解释。此外，行业层面的分类效应解释了企业IGE的很大份额，这表明跨行业的结构性壁垒——而非企业层面的歧视——是代际分类的关键驱动因素。

title: Regulation by Reputation? Intermediaries, Labor Abuses, and International Migration
title_zh: 声誉监管？中介、劳工虐待与国际移民
abstract: Migrant workers and employers rely on intermediaries to facilitate labor market placements. If information frictions obscure their reputation, however, intermediaries may underinvest in placement quality. Using data on more than 1.5 million Sri Lankan migrants to the Gulf region, we examine the effects of a government-run intermediary rating program that publicly revealed ratings two years after it was announced. Prior to the ratings’ public release, underperforming intermediaries invest in the rating criteria and place migrants in less abusive and more remunerative employment. Our results suggest the government’s threat of quality revelation induced intermediaries to prospectively screen employers and improve placement quality.
abstract_zh: 移民工人与雇主依赖中介机构促进劳动力市场匹配。然而，若信息摩擦掩盖了中介机构的声誉，其可能会在安置质量上投资不足。基于超过150万斯里兰卡移民至海湾地区的数据，我们考察了一项政府主导的中介评级计划的效果——该计划在公布两年后公开披露评级结果。在评级结果公开发布前，表现不佳的中介机构已针对评级标准进行投入，并将移民安置到虐待程度更低、薪酬更优的岗位。研究结果表明，政府以质量信息透明化为威慑手段，促使中介机构前瞻性地筛选雇主并提升安置质量。

title: Fast Likelihood‐Free Parameter Estimation for Lévy Processes
title_zh: 莱维过程的快速无似然参数估计
abstract: Lévy processes are widely used in financial modeling due to their ability to capture discontinuities and heavy tails, which are common in high‐frequency asset return data. However, parameter estimation remains a challenge when associated likelihoods are unavailable or costly to compute. We propose a fast and accurate method for Lévy parameter estimation using the neural Bayes estimation (NBE) framework—a simulation‐based, likelihood‐free approach that leverages permutation‐invariant neural networks to approximate Bayes estimators. We contribute new theoretical results, showing that NBE results in consistent estimators whose risk converges to that of the Bayes estimator under mild conditions. Moreover, through extensive simulations across several Lévy models, we show that NBE outperforms traditional methods in both accuracy and runtime, while also enabling two complementary approaches to uncertainty quantification. We illustrate our approach on a challenging high‐frequency cryptocurrency return dataset, where the method captures evolving parameter dynamics and delivers reliable and interpretable inference at a fraction of the computational cost of traditional methods. We investigate nearly a decade of high‐frequency Bitcoin returns, requiring less than one minute to estimate parameters under the proposed approach.
abstract_zh: 摘要 莱维过程因其能够捕捉高频资产收益数据中常见的间断性和厚尾特征，在金融建模中得到广泛应用。然而，当相关似然函数不可用或计算成本高昂时，参数估计仍面临挑战。我们提出了一种基于神经贝叶斯估计（NBE）框架的快速精确莱维参数估计方法——这是一种基于模拟的无似然方法，利用置换不变神经网络来近似贝叶斯估计量。我们贡献了新的理论成果，证明在温和条件下，NBE可得到一致估计量，其风险收敛至贝叶斯估计量的风险水平。此外，通过针对多个莱维模型的大量模拟实验，我们表明NBE在精度和运行时间上均优于传统方法，同时还能实现两种互补的不确定性量化方法。我们以具有挑战性的高频加密货币收益数据集为例进行方法验证，该方法能够捕捉动态变化的参数特征，并以传统方法计算成本的一小部分提供可靠且可解释的推断。我们研究了近十年高频比特币收益数据，在提出的方法下，参数估计耗时不足一分钟。

title: The Cost of Uncertainty: US–China Tariff Effects on Agricultural Commodity Markets
title_zh: 不确定性的代价：中美关税对农产品市场的影响
abstract: We examine the impact of US–China trade policy announcements on corn and soybean markets. Using time‐series models, our results show that prospective tariff announcements significantly increased implied volatility (IV), especially during the 2018–2019 trade war. Our results show that corn and soybean markets responded to both countries' announcements. We observe the strongest volatility impacts at the 90% and 95% strikes. Our results indicate that higher IV raised hedging costs for producers, further constricting farm margins– a 7.5% rise in IV increased soybean option premiums by approximately 3.75%. These findings highlight the financial burden imposed by trade policy uncertainty beyond its impact on commodity prices.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究了美中贸易政策公告对玉米和大豆市场的影响。基于时间序列模型的分析结果显示，预期关税公告显著提升了隐含波动率（IV），尤其在2018-2019年贸易战期间表现最为突出。研究表明，玉米和大豆市场对两国发布的公告均产生反应，其中在90%和95%执行价水平上观测到最强的波动效应。进一步分析表明，隐含波动率上升导致生产者的对冲成本增加，进而压缩农场利润空间——当隐含波动率上升7.5%时，大豆期权溢价相应增加约3.75%。这些发现揭示了贸易政策不确定性对商品价格影响之外，对市场参与者造成的额外财务负担。

title: Before the Exodus? Young Scientists and the Future of US Science
title_zh: 出走之前？青年科学家与美国科学的未来
authors: Pierre Azoulay, Raffaella Sadun, Daniela Scur
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Shortly after major policy changes to US science funding began in early 2025, we surveyed 916 young biomedical scientists – PhD students and postdoctoral researchers – about their career intentions and expectations. The results document a dramatic shift in sentiment. Barely half of respondents now say they are likely to remain in academia, down 22 percentage points from how they felt six months earlier. The fraction likely to stay in the United States fell by 21 percentage points. Even satisfaction with having pursued a PhD in science declined by 16 percentage points. These are not the complaints of established scientists defending their budgets, but rather the stated intentions of the next generation – the scientists who would, in ordinary times, become the principal investigators of the future.
abstract_zh: 2025年初美国科研经费重大政策调整后不久，我们针对916名青年生物医学科学家（博士生和博士后研究人员）开展了职业意向与预期调查。结果显示科研人员心态发生显著转变：目前仅半数受访者表示可能留在学术界，较六个月前下降22个百分点；可能留在美国工作的比例下降21个百分点；甚至对攻读科学博士学位的满意度也下降16个百分点。这并非资深科学家为维护预算而发出的抱怨，而是下一代科研工作者——在正常情况下本应成为未来首席研究员的群体——明确表达的职业规划。
